title: Suzhou Institute of Nano-Tech and Nano-Bionics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
content:
The Suzhou Institute of Nano-Tech and Nano-Bionics (SINANO) was jointly founded in March 2006 by the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Jiangsu Province and Suzhou Municipality, and focuses on nanomaterials and nanobiotechnology research and industrialization in the Suzhou Industrial Park.

Researchers at SINANO have developed aerogel fibers for thermal textiles, biomimetic encapsulated aerogel fibers inspired by polar bear hair, and silica aerogel-based platforms for functional nanocomposites.

Through technology transfer to companies in nano-new materials, the institute serves as a collaboration partner for aerogel fiber, film and composite development.
excerpt: CAS nanotechnology institute in Suzhou known for aerogel fiber research, including thermal textile fibers and biomimetic encapsulated aerogel fibers.
